annotations.title: Document to text: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF

description: Convert a document to text or Markdown: Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), PowerPoint (.pptx), PDF, plain UTF-8 text (.txt/.md/.csv/.json), and scans or images (PNG, JPEG, WebP) by OCR. Give a public URL or POST the file (10 MB default; 10-20 MB URLs retry once at 20 MB; images 3 MB). Old formats and protected files fail uncharged. Use for attachments, scans and spreadsheets in an agent, RAG or workflow. Example: url=https://calibre-ebook.com/downloads/demos/demo.docx. Price $0.005/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

format.description: markdown (default: headings, lists and tables kept) or text

maxBytes.description: Maximum file size in MB for a URL read (10 default, up to 20). If omitted, a file over 10 MB is retried once at 20 MB; an explicit value is respected

maxChars.description: Maximum characters of text returned (1000-200000, default 50000)

url.description: Absolute public http(s) URL of the file (or send the file in a POST body instead)
